claims: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew splashed down at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Orion capsule landed after a 10-day mission around the moon.
U.S. Navy recovery teams retrieved the astronauts.
The Artemis II crew was transported to the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II crew completed their lunar flyby.
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth
